Definition: from G1537 and the base of G2759; to transfix:--pierce.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to pierce through, to transfix, and it occurs twice, both times for the same wound. John quotes the prophet, They shall look on Him whom they pierced, and Revelation says every eye shall see Him, and they also who pierced Him, and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of Him. The word is the spear in His side, seen from the cross and from the end of the world.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the pierced One is the coming One, because the same wound that proved His death will prove His return.
